_comment: Measured properties of the serving stack, pinned like the dataset. These are not incidental: they bound which experiments are even valid, so they get the same treatment as provenance/datasets.json. Embedded whole into every manifest, which also means a run does not have to rely on env vars (LLM_SERVED_BY / LLM_QUANTIZATION) to record what served it.

effective_context_tokens.method: head/tail needle test. FIRST_MARKER=ALPHA7 at the very start of the prompt, LAST_MARKER=BETA9 at the very end, filler sized to ~2k / ~4k / ~8k tokens, asking the model to report both. At ~2000 and ~4000 tokens it returned FIRST=ALPHA7 LAST=BETA9. At ~8000 tokens it returned FIRST=<x> LAST=<BETA9>: the head was clipped, so the prompt was truncated from the front.
effective_context_tokens.consequence: k<=50 is safe (a k=50 context is ~2k tokens). `full` mode is NOT runnable: whole conversations are ~15k tokens and would be silently truncated from the front -- a `full` number would be an artifact. Do not report one until num_ctx is set explicitly and this test is re-run.
effective_context_tokens.why_not_declared: The model declares 32768, but ollama clamps the runtime num_ctx to its server default. Declared length is not effective length; only the test above settles it.

known_notes: Measured on a Colab free-tier Tesla T4. GPU model is recorded per run in the manifest's hardware block.
A fresh Colab runtime has no SSH key. Code is delivered as an uploaded git bundle, so no credential is ever placed on the VM. Do not reintroduce one.
